description: ST3289 is a subsequent course of ST3288; it is part of the Undergraduate Research Opportunities Programme in Science (UROPS). Students taking ST3288 can choose to take this course to extend their project period from one semester to two semesters under the supervision of the same faculty member. The aim of these courses are to provide opportunities for students to apply their learned theoretical knowledge and skills in statistics to scientific and applied research topics. In these courses, each student will independently work on a research project under the supervision of a faculty member.
